blueprintplanner.entered: Planner mode – redstone works like vanilla. Taking damage in the real world kicks you out.
blueprintplanner.enter.not_on_ground: You have to stand on the ground to enter the planner.
blueprintplanner.exit.damage: You took damage in the real world – left the planner!
blueprintplanner.error.crashed: The planner crashed (%s). Your real world keeps running; the report is in the crash-reports folder.
blueprintplanner.hud.title: [PLANNER]
blueprintplanner.settings.title: Planner settings
blueprintplanner.settings.not_running: The planner is not running – simulation values are available inside the planner.
blueprintplanner.settings.isolate.toolti: Other mods (e.g. Distant Horizons, voice chat, minimaps) don't notice the planner server and its connection and keep working with your real world. Only turn off if a mod really has to run inside the planner. Changes apply the next time the planner starts (after leaving the world).
blueprintplanner.settings.reset.confirm: All blocks in the chunks around you will be removed in the planner. Continue?
blueprintplanner.tools.title: Building tools
blueprintplanner.tools.selection_hint: No selection – wooden axe: left click = corner 1, right click = corner 2 (or [ and ])
blueprintplanner.tools.blocks: Block A (main hand): %s · Block B (off hand): %s
blueprintplanner.tools.planner_only: Building tools only work inside the planner.
blueprintplanner.tools.no_clipboard: The clipboard is empty – copy something first.
blueprintplanner.save.title: Save blueprint
blueprintplanner.save.name: Name
blueprintplanner.save.place_real: Show as hologram in the real world
blueprintplanner.save.overwrite: A blueprint with this name already exists and will be overwritten.
blueprintplanner.save.source_real: Source: real world (only what your client knows)
blueprintplanner.library.title: Blueprints
blueprintplanner.library.empty: No blueprints yet. Select an area and save it.
blueprintplanner.placement.paste_confirm: The placement is built into the real world right away (directly in singleplayer, via /setblock on servers – op only).
blueprintplanner.paste.no_permission: Building directly needs singleplayer or op. Use the hologram + easy place instead.
blueprintplanner.materials.title: Material list: %s
blueprintplanner.easyplace.on: Easy place: ON – blocks placed into the hologram get the right orientation
blueprintplanner.settings.sky.tooltip: How the sky looks in the planner, so you see at a glance that you are not in the real world. Shader packs often draw their own sky.
blueprintplanner.settings.viewdistance.t: Chunk radius the planner keeps loaded around you (Auto = your render distance). You can only see as far as your render distance in the video settings.
blueprintplanner.settings.simdistance.to: Chunk radius in which redstone, water, plants and mobs keep running in the planner (Auto = your simulation distance). Raise it for big machines; the loaded chunks are raised along with it.
blueprintplanner.enter.replay: The planner is not available while a replay is playing.
blueprintplanner.compat.litematica: Note: Litematica is installed. It treats the planner as a world change and can overwrite the placements of your real world. Removing Litematica (and MaLiLib) is recommended; Blueprint Planner has holograms, material lists and easy place itself.
blueprintplanner.compat.flashback: Flashback: start the recording after leaving the planner.
blueprintplanner.settings.stick.tooltip: With a stick in your hand you move holograms in the real world: right click picks up the hologram you look at, it then follows your crosshair until the next right click. Left click selects, sneak + mouse wheel pushes it 1 block along your view.
blueprintplanner.library.place.tooltip: The hologram sticks to your crosshair: aim, right click drops it, left click cancels. Sneak + mouse wheel = height, K = rotate.
blueprintplanner.library.place.tooltip_p: Creates the hologram for the real world (at its original spot or in front of you). Leave the planner to aim it (not as a spectator).
Puts the blueprint into the selected area (set corners with [ and ], works from far away): on its floor, centered. If it only fits turned, it is turned. With only one corner set, it is centered on that block.
blueprintplanner.library.to_planner.tool: Planner only: the blueprint sticks to your crosshair, right click pastes it there (undoable), left click cancels.
blueprintplanner.placement.move.tooltip: The hologram follows your crosshair: right click drops it, left click puts it back. Also works with a stick: look at the hologram + right click.
blueprintplanner.tool.carrying: "%s" follows your crosshair – right click drops, left click cancels
blueprintplanner.tool.hud.carry: ✥ %s at %s %s %s – right click: drop · left click: cancel
blueprintplanner.tool.hud.carry_planner: ✥ %s at %s %s %s – right click: paste · left click: cancel
blueprintplanner.tool.hud.aim: Aim at a block (up to 128 blocks away)
blueprintplanner.tool.hud.stick: ✥ Stick: right click = pick up hologram · left click = select (%s)
blueprintplanner.tool.hud.stick_keys: %s: rotate · sneak + mouse wheel: 1 block along your view
blueprintplanner.tool.hud.home: %s (middle click): to the spot the blueprint was saved from
blueprintplanner.error.kicked: The planner was stopped by its own server: %s (usually caused by another mod, details in logs/latest.log)
blueprintplanner.keys.conflict: Blueprint Planner: these keys are used twice. Minecraft triggers both, and the planner's key press is often lost. Change them in Options → Controls:
blueprintplanner.compat.xaero_map: The world map shows the real world – open it after leaving the planner.
blueprintplanner.compat.xaero_waypoint: Waypoints can be added after leaving the planner.
blueprintplanner.layer.on: Layer mode: ON – only layer y=%s is shown
blueprintplanner.placement.layer.tooltip: Shows only one height of the selected hologram, to build it layer by layer. Keys: %s/%s = layer down/up, %s = on/off. The material list and 'Build now' then cover this layer only.
